meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装一个本地监控面板：安装 npm 包并接入 pusher，每 60 秒推一次 JSON 快照、每 2 秒推日志，在 3100 端口展示 agent 分组、会话、频道、token 用量和实时日志。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 加监控面板、或运行 /add-dashboard 时触发，按步骤装包、复制并接入 pusher、配置 .env、重启服务并做冒烟检查。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加个监控面板
say.note: 会装包、改 index.ts、并让你填 .env

say.text: 把 DASHBOARD_PORT 改成 3200 后重启面板
say.note: 改 .env 里的端口，再重启服务

say.text: 检查面板是否已经跑起来

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw: installs the npm package and a pusher that posts JSON snapshots every 60s and logs every 2s, showing groups, sessions, channels, token usage and logs on port 3100.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw or run /add-dashboard; it installs the package, wires the pusher, sets .env, restarts the service and smoke-checks it.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Installs the package, edits index.ts, asks for .env values

say_en.text: Change DASHBOARD_PORT to 3200 and restart the dashboard
say_en.note: Edits the .env port, then restarts the service

say_en.text: Check whether the dashboard is running
